title: Monster authoring schema candidate v1 — structural validation
description: CANDIDATE authoring schema (docs/architecture/OTERYN_MONSTER_AUTHORING_SCHEMA_V1.md). Not a WorldProject/v2 contract or runtime activation; semantic rules live in validate_monster.py.

key.description: Namespaced authoring key. Native ProductionKey validation still applies at integration.

percent.description: Percent 0..100; 0.19 means 0.19%. At most 4 decimal places (0.0001% = 1 ppm), enforced by validate_monster.py so that binary-float JSON Schema validators accept valid values. Native ppm = percent * 10000, which must be an exact integer.

ms.description: Positive duration/interval in milliseconds; no implicit source-unit conversion.

ratio.description: Exact rational number in lowest terms (gcd(|numerator|, denominator) = 1, so zero is 0/1), matching WorldProject/v2 validate_v2_ratio. Percent values represent percentage points, not fractions of one.

nonnegativePercent.description: Exact rational number in lowest terms (gcd(|numerator|, denominator) = 1, so zero is 0/1), matching WorldProject/v2 validate_v2_ratio. Percent values represent percentage points, not fractions of one.

conditionType.description: Canonical condition key; source aliases require an explicit import mapping.

locations.description: Original editorial location text, not world spawn coordinates.

skip_later_same_item_after_success.description: On a successful positive-quantity drop, suppress later entries with the same exact Item identity in this ordered table invocation. Zero quantity does not suppress; nested/separate calls have separate scope.

loot.description: Only the source-supported independent base table is in this schema. Other native algorithms retain their own accepted contracts.

ability.description: For area casts, center precedence is required target position, facing-adjacent position when needs_direction, then caster position. Native execution and no-area target selection require separate qualification.

damageOverTime.description: Nominal source damage budget, not per-tick magnitude or a promise of exact summed damage. Native schedule parity requires separate qualification.

document.description: Original paragraphs; no translation, correction, or paraphrase during import. Partial source text remains blocked in the import manifest.

weight_centioz.description: Proposal authoring unit: 0.01 oz. Not inferred from absent XML attributes.

item.description: Verification projection of canonical Item capabilities. Not an independent Item truth authority or full native Item serialization. ItemRef must resolve to the canonical Item catalogue before runtime admission.
